passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: The following Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations (“MD&A”) should be read in conjunction with the other sections of this Form 10-K, including our consolidated financial statements and related notes contained in Item 8, and the discussion of risk factors that may affect future results in Item 1A. All references to “Notes” in this MD&A are to Notes to our consolidated financial statements in Item 8. Additionally, refer to Item 7. MD&A in our 2024 Annual Report on Form 10-K for management’s discussion and analysis of financial condition and results of operations for the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to the year ended December 31, 2023, which we filed with the SEC on February 26, 2025 and is incorporated by reference into this Form 10-K. In this MD&A section, we refer to the following “adjusted” financial measures: adjusted operating companies income (loss) (“OCI”); adjusted OCI margins; adjusted net earnings; adjusted diluted earnings per share (“EPS”); and adjusted effective tax rates. We also refer to the ratio of debt-to-Consolidated EBITDA (earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization, as defined in our credit agreement, which includes certain adjustments). These financial measures are not required by, or calculated in accordance with, GAAP and may not be calculated the same as similarly titled measures used by other companies. These financial measures should thus be considered as supplemental in nature and not considered in isolation or as a substitute for the related financial information prepared in accordance with GAAP. For a further description of these non-GAAP financial measures, see the Non-GAAP Financial Measures section below. Executive Summary Our Business We have a leading portfolio of tobacco products for U.S. tobacco consumers age 21+. We are Moving Beyond Smoking TM , by responsibly transitioning adult smokers to a smoke-free future, competing vigorously for existing smoke-free adult nicotine consumers and exploring new growth opportunities - beyond the United States and beyond nicotine. Our wholly owned subsidiaries include leading manufacturers of both combustible and smoke-free products. In combustibles, we own PM USA, the most profitable U.S. cigarette manufacturer, and Middleton, a leading U.S. cigar manufacturer. In smoke-free products, we own USSTC, the leading global MST manufacturer, Helix, a leading manufacturer of oral nicotine pouches, and NJOY, an e-vapor manufacturer with products covered by MGOs from the FDA. Additionally, we have a majority-owned joint venture, Horizon, for the U.S. marketing and commercialization of HTS products. The brand portfolios of our operating companies include Marlboro , Black & Mild , Copenhagen , Skoal , on! and NJOY . Trademarks related to Altria referenced in this Form 10-K are the property of Altria or our subsidiaries or are used with permission. Our investments in equity securities include ABI, the world’s largest brewer, and Cronos, a leading Canadian cannabinoid company. For a description of Altria, see Item 1. General Development of Business When used in this Annual Report on Form 10-K (“Form 10-K”), the terms “Altria,” “we,” “us” and “our” refer to either (i) Altria Group, Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries or (ii) Altria Group, Inc. only and not its consolidated subsidiaries, as appropriate in the context. We have a leading portfolio of tobacco products for U.S. tobacco consumers age 21+. We are Moving Beyond Smoking TM , by responsibly transitioning adult smokers to a smoke-free future, competing vigorously for existing smoke-free adult nicotine consumers and exploring new growth opportunities - beyond the United States and beyond nicotine (“Vision”). Our wholly owned subsidiaries include Philip Morris USA Inc. (“PM USA”), which is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cigarettes; John Middleton Co. (“Middleton”), which is engaged in the manufacture and sale of machine-made large cigars and is a wholly owned subsidiary of PM USA; UST LLC (“UST”), which, through its wholly owned subsidiary U.S. Smokeless Tobacco Company LLC (“USSTC”), is engaged in the manufacture and sale of moist smokeless tobacco (“MST”) products; Helix Innovations LLC (“Helix”) and its foreign affiliates (“Helix International”), which are engaged in the manufacture and sale of oral nicotine pouches; and NJOY, LLC (“NJOY”), which is engaged in the manufacture and sale of e-vapor products. We operate primarily within the United States and generate substantially all of our revenue from domestic customers. Other wholly owned subsidiaries include Altria Group Distribution Company (“AGDC”), which provides domestic sales and distribution services to our operating companies, and Altria Client Services LLC (“ALCS”), which provides various support services to our companies in areas such as legal, regulatory, research and product development, consumer engagement, finance, human resources and external affairs. credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow comfortably covers capital expenditure, leaving substantial free cash flow that supports debt service and shareholder returns. The business generates high margins and stable cash flows from leading tobacco brands, providing a strong foundation for credit quality.

Interest coverage remains robust, with operating income covering interest expense multiple times over. This ample cushion, combined with a long-dated maturity profile and no significant near-term maturities, supports the issuer's ability to service debt through economic cycles.

key_risks.text: Revenue and operating income have declined over recent years, reflecting secular volume pressures in the tobacco sector. Continued erosion could weaken cash flow generation and pressure credit metrics, especially if offsetting growth in smoke-free products does not materialize as expected.

The debt structure includes a large portion of long-term notes with maturities extending beyond the next five years, but the current portion of long-term debt is significant relative to cash. Refinancing risk is mitigated by strong cash flow, yet dependence on capital markets remains a consideration.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Free cash flow to debt is solid, indicating that internally generated funds can repay a meaningful portion of debt annually. This ratio compares favorably to sector peers, suggesting above-average debt servicing capacity relative to the industry.

Net leverage sits below the sector median, reflecting moderate indebtedness after netting cash. The company retains headroom against indicative downgrade thresholds, but an upgrade would require further deleveraging or EBITDA growth, which may be constrained by declining operating income.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer maintains an intermediate financial risk profile, supported by strong cash flow and moderate leverage. While revenue and operating income trends are negative, the company's leading market position and cash generation provide resilience. We view the credit outlook as stable, with capacity to absorb modest declines.

Shareholder distributions absorb a substantial portion of free cash flow, limiting flexibility for debt reduction. However, the long-dated maturity profile and ample liquidity mitigate refinancing risk. We expect leverage to remain within the intermediate tier, with potential for improvement if cash flow stabilizes.

credit_strengths.text: 營運現金流足以輕鬆覆蓋資本支出，留下大量自由現金流以支持債務償付及股東回報。該業務憑藉領先的煙草品牌產生高利潤率及穩定現金流，為信貸質量提供堅實基礎。
利息覆蓋率保持穩健，營運收入覆蓋利息支出達數倍。此充裕緩衝，加上長期到期結構及並無重大短期到期債務，支持發行人於經濟週期中償付債務的能力。

key_risks.text: 收入及營運收入於近年下降，反映煙草行業的長期銷量壓力。持續侵蝕可能削弱現金流產生並對信貸指標構成壓力，尤其是若無煙產品的抵銷增長未能如預期實現。
債務結構包括大部分為到期日延伸至未來五年以後的長期票據，但長期債務的流動部分相對於現金而言規模顯著。再融資風險因強勁現金流而緩解，惟對資本市場的依賴仍是一項考量。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 自由現金流對債務比率穩健，表明內部產生的資金可每年償還相當部分債務。此比率與行業同業相比較為有利，顯示相對於行業的債務償付能力高於平均水平。
淨槓桿率低於行業中位數，反映扣除現金後負債適中。公司相對於指示性降級閾值保留緩衝空間，但升級將需要進一步去槓桿或EBITDA增長，而這可能因營運收入下降而受到限制。

overall_credit_view.text: 發行人維持中等財務風險狀況，受強勁現金流及適度槓桿支持。儘管收入及營運收入趨勢為負面，公司的領先市場地位及現金產生能力提供韌性。我們認為信貸展望穩定，具備吸收適度下降的能力。
股東分派吸收大部分自由現金流，限制債務削減的靈活性。然而，長期到期結構及充裕流動性緩解再融資風險。我們預期槓桿率將維持於中等級別，若現金流穩定則有改善潛力。
